                     distr='logit')
res = model.fit(method='bfgs')
print(res.summary())

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from statsmodels.miscmodels.ordinal_model import OrderedModel

dm = pd.read_csv('TASK008_BCG-CORONA_DM.csv')

model_agg = OrderedModel.from_formula('AESEV ~ C(expect_interact) + C(patients_seen) + C(TRTGRP)', df_agg, distr='logit')
res_agg = model_agg.fit(method='bfgs', disp=False)

print(np.exp(res_agg.params))
